item.title: Now
item.description:
This is a now page, detailing what I am currently focused on.

The Basics

  • I currently live in Leicester, UK
  • I have a black cat called Lara (as in Croft)
  • I work as a Senior Developer & Cloud Architect at CWA
  • I’m a certified Google Cloud Architect

What are my Interests?

Technical

  • Web development (mainly PHP) and design
  • DevOps and Cloud Architecture
  • Automation and simplifying complex processes

IRL

  • I row most weekends with Leicester Rowing Club
  • After climbing Snowdown in March 2026, I’ve recently re-discovered a love of hiking
  • Generally trying to live a more sustainable, healthy lifestyle
  • I’m a keen coffee drinker, particularly beans
  • I’m slowly building up my vinyl collection

What do I Use?

Devices

  • Google Pixel 9 Pro
  • 2024 Macbook Air
  • AMD Ryzen based mini server running Proxmox VE that I run a mix of VMs on, along with a couple of development boxes.
  • Gaming-wise, I have an XBOX Series X, but not gaming that much these days

Software

  • For web development, my editor of choice is JetBrains PhpStorm
  • Music wise I switched to Apple Music at the start of 2026, having used Spotify since 2008
  • Hosting wise, I tend to use Fasthosts, although this site is currently on GitHub pages

(This page was last updated in April 2026.)
